learning_objective: 🎯 Time to pose! Today we will learn fun Yoga asanas (poses) inspired by animals and nature to build our balance and strength.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Stand up very straight, keep your feet together, and put your arms by your sides. Breathe and feel as strong as a tall mountain!
Stand on one leg, place the other foot on your inner leg, and join your hands above your head. Balance like a steady tree!

fun_activity.title: 🦁 The Lion Roar
fun_activity.instructions: Kneel down, place your hands on your knees, open your eyes wide, stick your tongue out, and make a loud, funny lion roar to let out all your stress!

quick_recap: ⭐ Yoga poses help us improve our balance and concentration.
⭐ Never force a stretch. Just do what feels comfortable and fun for your body!
